# Keys

Every key is resolved by one pure function over an enumerated state machine (TUI-DESIGN §3), never by handler order. Contexts in precedence order: minsize · overlay · picker · composer · global. Rebind through `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/jevcode/keybindings.json` (`--keybindings <file>`, `JEVCODE_KEYBINDINGS`): `{ "namespace:action": "ctrl+g" | ["?", "f1"] | "ctrl+x ctrl+s" | "none" }` — a value with two space-separated keys is a chord completed within 3 s; `"none"`/`null` unbinds; reserved keys and unknown ids are refused with a `jevcode.log` warning, never fatally; `/help reload` re-reads the file.

Reserved and never rebindable (A24): `Ctrl+C`, `Ctrl+D`, `Ctrl+M`, `Ctrl+[`, `Ctrl+I` (Enter, Esc and Tab are the same bytes).

## Ctrl-C / Esc / Ctrl-D

Windows: Ctrl-C ×2 within 1.5 s, Esc Esc within 2 s, Ctrl-D ×2 within 800 ms, Esc re-buffer 30 ms (a letter inside it is the Alt chord). The draft rule outranks the review rule: Ctrl-C with text clears the draft (to history, secrets masked) wherever you are; Ctrl-C with an empty draft aborts a live run (session mode stays, one-shot exits 130) or, under a pending review, aborts the run without committing a decline; Ctrl-C ×2 idle exits 0. Esc pauses a live run at the next step boundary, Esc Esc aborts; on an idle empty composer Esc Esc opens the rewind/steer menu. Ctrl-D with text deletes forward; on an empty composer Ctrl-D ×2 exits 0 (with a live run it asks `a run is live: [y] abort and exit   [n] stay`). See TUI-DESIGN §3.3 for the full matrix.
